description:
Design a printable PCB housing (open-top box) with 4 internal standoffs and a USB port cutout. 

**Specifications:**
1. **Main Box:**
   - External Dimensions: 100mm (Length X) × 60mm (Width Y) × 30mm (Height Z)
   - Wall & Floor Thickness: 2mm uniform
   - Open at the top (Positive Z face)

2. **Internal Standoffs (4x):**
   - Shape: Cylindrical posts on the internal floor
   - Diameter: 6mm
   - Height: 5mm (from internal floor)
   - Spacing: 80mm apart in X, 40mm apart in Y (Centered in the box)
   - Holes: 2.5mm diameter through-hole (through post and box floor)

3. **USB Port Cutout:**
   - Location: Right face (X = +50mm face)
   - Size: 12mm width (Y) × 12mm height (Z)
   - Position: Centered horizontally on the face, bottom edge 5mm above internal floor

Save the result as `/home/ga/Documents/FreeCAD/pcb_housing.FCStd`.
